title: Design language
lede: Warm minimal, for a family dentist. Calm enough for a nervous adult, friendly enough for a four-year-old, and specific enough to feel like a real neighbourhood practice.

items.title: Calm over clinical
items.text: No hospital blue, no stock tooth renders. Paper tones, forest ink and real people.

items.title: Say the price
items.text: Copy is plain and specific. Real prices, real times, no "starting from".

items.title: Motion explains
items.text: Every animation reveals order or depth. Nothing loops for show, and reduced motion turns it all off.

colour.title: Colour
colour.intro: One accent. Bloom is a tint, used once per section at most, never on a control. Each theme is designed on its own terms.

swatches.name: Linden paper
swatches.use: Page background. A pale, slightly green paper rather than cream.

swatches.name: Moss
swatches.use: Secondary text. Passes AA on every surface.

swatches.name: Linden green
swatches.use: The one accent. Buttons, links, active states.

swatches.name: Blossom
swatches.use: Quiet tint for one highlight per section. Never on controls.

type.title: Type
type.intro: Bricolage Grotesque for display: warm, slightly irregular, with optical sizes. Figtree for text: round and very readable. Emphasis uses colour, never italics.

specimens.label: Body
specimens.sample: We book longer appointments and explain before we touch anything.

components.title: Shape and components
components.intro: Media and panels use soft corners (28px for photos, 18px for cards). Every interactive control is a pill. That rule holds on every page.

motion.title: Motion
motion.intro: GSAP with ScrollTrigger and SplitText. Each effect is opt-in by data attribute, moves only position and opacity, and switches off for anyone who prefers reduced motion.

items.name: Hero opening
items.why: Draws the eye to the photo first, then the promise.
items.how: clip-path inset to full frame, image eases from 1.28 to 1.08 scale, card lifts in last.

items.name: Line reveals
items.why: Gives each section heading a clear arrival without moving body text.
items.how: GSAP SplitText lines in a mask, once, on enter.

items.name: Manifesto fill
items.why: Reads the core promise at the visitor's pace.
items.how: Words go from 16% to 100% opacity, scrubbed to scroll.

items.name: First-visit pan
items.why: Tells the appointment as a sequence, which is what nervous patients want to know.
items.how: Section pins at the top; vertical scroll moves the track sideways. Swipeable list on touch screens.

items.name: Service preview
items.why: Puts a face to each service without adding images to the list.
items.how: A photo follows the cursor and swaps per row. Fine pointers only.

items.name: Parallax frames
items.why: Adds depth to framed photos so the calm layout does not feel flat.
items.how: Image drifts within its frame, about 5 to 8 percent.

items.name: Reading progress
items.why: Shows how much of a journal post is left.
items.how: A 3px bar under the nav, scrubbed to the article.

inspiration.title: Inspiration
inspiration.intro: UK and US studios only. We studied each one and took a single idea from it.

items.title: Dental Website, Confidence Before the Appointment
items.took: Warm off-white base and a small card sitting on the hero photo. Ours carries opening hours instead of a booking widget.

items.title: Bloom, mental health clinic
items.took: The inset, rounded photo frame. It became the hero reveal: the frame opens out from an inset clip.

items.title: Atelier Aesthetica, aesthetic clinic
items.took: Calm pacing, generous margins and short, declarative headlines.

items.title: Website and motion concept for a dentist clinic
items.took: Real, diverse faces and motion that feels playful without being loud. The cursor-follow photo on the services list comes from here.

items.title: Women's hormone clinic
items.took: A single reassuring sentence given the whole screen. That is our scroll-filled manifesto.

items.title: Dental clinic landing page
items.took: Big confident type set against photography, and process explained as a sequence of image cards.

items.title: Nova Dental, team page
items.took: Large portraits with a human detail beside each one, which shaped our team bios.

seo.description: The design system behind the Linden Dental Studio concept site: colour, type, shape, motion and the UK/US work that inspired it.
